elements.element: Vendor must maintain Commercial General Liability insurance with a minimum limit of USD 1,000,000 per occurrence.
elements.evidence: Section 11.6.1(c) requires General Liability Insurance, but the per-occurrence limit is shown only as [***], so the required USD 1,000,000 limit cannot be established.

elements.element: Vendor must maintain Commercial General Liability insurance with a minimum aggregate limit of USD 2,000,000.
elements.evidence: Section 11.6.1(c) states an aggregate limit only as [***], so the required USD 2,000,000 aggregate cannot be established.

elements.element: Vendor must maintain Professional Liability (Errors and Omissions) insurance with a minimum limit of USD 2,000,000.
elements.evidence: The added operative sentence requires Harpoon to carry Professional Liability insurance at only USD 1,000,000.

elements.element: If Vendor processes Customer Data, Vendor must maintain Cyber and Privacy Liability insurance with a minimum limit of USD 5,000,000.
elements.evidence: The clause does not demonstrate that Harpoon does not process Customer Data, and the added Cyber and Privacy Liability limit is only USD 2,000,000 rather than USD 5,000,000.

elements.element: Vendor must maintain workers' compensation insurance as required by applicable law.
elements.evidence: Section 11.6.1(a) requires statutory workers' compensation for employees in U.S. states but expressly excludes Puerto Rico and does not address other jurisdictions; therefore it does not fully impose coverage wherever applicable law requires it.

elements.element: Vendor must provide certificates of insurance upon request.
elements.evidence: Section 11.6.2 requires either Party, including Harpoon, to provide certificates evidencing compliance when requested by the other Party.

elements.element: Vendor must maintain Professional Liability (Errors and Omissions) insurance with a minimum limit of USD 1,000,000.
elements.evidence: The added operative sentence expressly requires Harpoon to carry Professional Liability (Errors and Omissions) Insurance with a minimum limit of USD 1,000,000.

elements.element: Vendor must maintain Cyber and Privacy Liability insurance with a minimum limit of USD 2,000,000.
elements.evidence: The added operative sentence expressly requires Harpoon to carry Cyber and Privacy Liability Insurance with a minimum limit of USD 2,000,000.

result.reason: The operative addition exactly reaches the stated fallback E&O and cyber limits but not the preferred USD 2 million E&O or USD 5 million cyber limits. The redacted General Liability limits do not establish the preferred USD 1 million per-occurrence and USD 2 million aggregate thresholds, and the workers' compensation obligation is jurisdictionally narrower than an unqualified applicable-law requirement. The amendment is otherwise targeted and does not contradict the existing insurance framework. Drafting quality is reduced by unresolved operative placeholders, an incomplete claims-made continuation provision, skipped subsection lettering, and failure to specify whether the added E&O and cyber limits apply per claim, per occurrence, or in the aggregate.
